articles.headline: Meta adds clearer safety warning after vulnerability in AI agent Muse
articles.summary: Meta is adding a clearer warning inside Muse after a security researcher found a vulnerability that could expose sensitive personal information. For businesses adopting AI assistants, this underscores rising operational and compliance risk around data handling, user safety, and secure deployment.

articles.headline: OpenAI reportedly preparing cybersecurity-focused GPT-6 Cyber preview
articles.summary: OpenAI is set to preview a cybersecurity-focused model and launch a product to help customers deploy it more securely and automatically. That could matter for enterprises facing mounting cyber risk, because it suggests stronger demand for AI security tooling and safer automation workflows.

articles.headline: Akamai jumps on AI infrastructure deal tied to Anthropic
articles.summary: Akamai stock surged after news of a major AI infrastructure deal with Anthropic that appears to rely on AI accelerators other than Nvidia GPUs. The story matters to businesses because it points to changing compute economics, supplier mix, and pricing pressure across AI infrastructure.
